facts.fact: DGSN's ID4Africa 2026 playbook says Morocco's digital identity platform, built on the national CNIE card and authenticating by PIN or fingerprint, has 5 million unique users and 15 million transactions since 2022.
DGSN says the digital identity platform serves 73 services and 54 partners, including CNSS, AMO, the judicial record and Massar, and banks, insurers and telecoms use it for instant KYC.
DGSN says the CNIE digitised on a smartphone is now used on a par with the physical card, derived at public kiosks or on a non-NFC phone, with online authentication on compatible services.

MAR.note: No link between civil register and ID stated.
DGSSI named only as a security-standards partner; no body creation, incident or designation stated.
Nothing on rural internet programmes or rural-urban use.
The 73 services are those using the ID platform's authentication; no portal or online transactions stated.
5 million unique users of the platform (12 per cent of the working population) is platform use, not national ID enrolment of the whole population.
DGSN named as identity authority; operation and maintenance not stated.
Names services using ID authentication, not registers keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: DGSN's playbook presents the CNIE national identity card as the single reference at the centre of Morocco's digital identity architecture, in use by 5 million platform users.

MAR.note: Fingerprint is used to authenticate, not stated to stop double enrolment; no certification or audit.

facts.fact: DGSN says social protection bodies CNSS and AMO, the judicial record and the Massar education system check people against the digital identity.
DGSN says social protection, justice, education, and banks (GPBM), insurers and telecoms rely on the digital identity for instant KYC and remote contract signing.

DGSN reports 73 services, 54 partners and 15 million transactions since 2022 (9.2 million in 2025, 2.7 million in the first quarter of 2026), and over 1.5 million authentications for the AFCON 2025 Yalla app.
